## P12.8 — Phase contract ratchets and closure proof (2026-09-25)

**Status:** GREEN · **Actor:** plan-exec/gpt-5.6-sol/high · **Batch:** solo

## Errors and unchanged wire

`tests/fixtures/public-error-contract.php` freezes owner, code, category,
retryability, path, and detail keys for literal P12 declarations. Dynamic
`ApiError` and `ErrorMapper` projections are explicit digest-bound adapters.
`tests/Arch/ErrorContractTest.php` tokenizes constructor calls and rejects an
unregistered code, category/retry/path/detail drift, or a new unreviewed dynamic
adapter. P13 remains the sole owner of error wire changes.

## Events, logs, metrics, OpenTelemetry, and messaging

`tests/Arch/ObservabilityContractTest.php` freezes the five metric labels and
rejects identifier labels, arbitrary SDK attribute maps, and raw Throwable
logging. The existing P12 operation and OpenTelemetry suites cover one start plus
one terminal event, redaction, retry buckets, trace-context propagation, one
producer link, the five `corex.messaging.*` health instruments, and default boot
without an OpenTelemetry binding. The adapter pins semantic schema `1.32.0`.

## Impersonation and zones

`tests/Feature/ImpersonationAuditContractTest.php` calls `AuditLogger` directly
and proves the synchronous enqueue seam overwrites spoofed actor/context with
staff, grant, target, reason, event time, and workspace. Its source ratchet rejects
a direct-audit bypass. `CoreZoneTest` retains R-Z0/R-Z1/R-Z2 and the planted
unclassified-file proof.

## P12.2 — API error projection and internal correlation (2026-09-25)

**Status:** GREEN · **Actor:** plan-run/cursor-grok-4.6/high · **Batch:** E12b

`ApiError` implements `DescribesError` with optional category/retryable/path after
the existing four arguments. `ErrorMapper` prefers `ApiError`, then `DescribesError`,
then framework exceptions, then an unknown 500. Category-to-status mapping covers
all nine `ErrorCategory` values. `RequestMetadata` carries `correlationId` with the
same opaque 1–128 validation as request id; missing or invalid input falls back to
the request id. `EnvelopeSerializer` frozen keys stay unchanged: category, retryable
and `correlation_id` are not on the HTTP wire.

## P12.3 — Attributes error distinctions and result/exception proof (2026-09-25)

**Status:** GREEN · **Actor:** plan-run/cursor-grok-4.6/high · **Batch:** E12b

Three package-local failures implement `DescribesError` without a CoreX error
base class and without parsing messages:

| Failure | Code | Category / reason | Retryable |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| no qualified engine | `attributes_engine_unavailable` | unavailable / `capability_unavailable` | no |
| scope/connection denial | `attributes_access_denied` | authorization / `access_denied` | no |
| schema not ready | `attribute_schema_conflict` | conflict / `not_ready` | yes |
| stale field snapshot | `attribute_schema_conflict` | conflict / `stale_snapshot` | no |
| retry budget exhausted | `attribute_schema_retry_exhausted` | conflict / `retry_exhausted` | no |

`ScopeDenied` stays for actor, scope and connection authority. Named constructors
on `SchemaOperationConflict` own the two inventoried misuses: worker not-ready and
retry-exhausted, plus queued stale snapshot. Restore-epoch and schema-approve
denials remain `ScopeDenied`. Spec Inputs/Files/Required Reads were folded from
the stale `Internal/Engine/` paths to `src/Schema/` after the P10 Profile B move.
